hi Erica,
 one possibility is that the EDF session column is not indicating 12 sessions, I can't tell from what you've provided (but the TDF looks right!). I'd be glad to try and debug this for you if it's not figured out yet (be sure to send R script and R data objects to my personal email).
regards
andy


On Mon, Jul 15, 2024 at 2:26 PM Erica Jordan <ericaf...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi, 

I'm trying to run a multi-session, I have 12 unique sessions each with the same 12 cameras. I've changed the EDF from a tibble to a dataframe but getting 'length(tdf) != apparent number of sessions'. Any advice much appreciated, thanks in advance. Erica

> aju.data <-
+   data2oscr(edf = dfaju_edf,
+             tdf = list(aju_tdf2,aju_tdf4,aju_tdf6,aju_tdf8,aju_tdf10,aju_tdf12,
+                        aju_tdf14,aju_tdf16,aju_tdf18,aju_tdf20,aju_tdf22,aju_tdf24),
+             sess.col = which(colnames(dfaju_edf)%in%"SESSION"),
+             id.col = which(colnames(dfaju_edf)%in%"ANIMAL_ID"),
+             occ.col = which(colnames(dfaju_edf)%in%"SO"),
+             trap.col = which(colnames(dfaju_edf)%in%"TRAP_ID"),
+             K = c(102,177,108,174,182,184,108,22,26,81,55,9), # no of sampling occ. per session
+             ntraps = rep(12,12))
length(tdf) != apparent number of sessions
